description: This file defines React components for UI alert elements, including Alert, AlertTitle, and AlertDescription. It utilizes class-variance-authority for styling variants and composes styled div elements with accessibility attributes.

methods.name: Alert
methods.description: React functional component rendering an alert container div with styling and accessible roles, accepting className, variant, and other props.
